messages:
Irene (CSM): NimbusCorp dedicated bring-up scheduled TOMORROW 09:00 PT. Need quota bump, autoscale shadow, and a short quality sweep. Also capture renewal risk if cost rises >10%. Who can own?
Kai (Solutions Eng): I can run the traffic and collect sample responses. What numbers are we aiming for?
Marta (Infra): Propose 180 reserved units for 09:00-11:00 PT. Autoscale shadow to 200% allowed.
Irene (CSM): 180 OK. Customer is sensitive to cost; flag any token burn >10% vs baseline. We'll surface in renewal notes.
Liam (Oncall): I'll be oncall. Add a 5m canary at 09:05 with 10 rps to test model swap and fallback. Abort conditions: p99 > 600ms or error rate >1% for 2m.
Kai (Solutions Eng): Plan: 09:00 smoke -> 09:05 canary -> 09:10 ramp to 320 rps over 20m -> 10:30 soak -> 10:55 drain. I'll push script to /runs/nimbus/bringup/.
Marta (Infra): Ops: enable KV prefix cache, batching target 6, and log token counters. Also toggle quant profile test qc=fast to measure cost delta.
Irene (CSM): We'll run a 10-min customer dry-run at 08:30 PT with their top prompt set. I'll send invite.
Liam (Oncall): Rollback checklist: 1) stop load 2) revert pool to baseline (70 units) 3) disable cache & quant flag 4) route traffic to stable model 5) open bridge if persistent errors.
Kai (Solutions Eng): Post-run checks: curl /api/pools/nimbus -> check units/healthy/p99; sample 100 responses and compare fuzz against baseline.
SchedulerBot: Run scheduled: id run-2387654321-nimbus, window 09:00-11:00 PT, dry-run 08:30, owner Kai.
Irene (CSM): I'll collect enablement feedback via a 3-question form after the debrief. Debrief 11:15 PT. Please ACK. :thumbsup:
Kai (Solutions Eng): ACK. Uploading scripts now.
Marta (Infra): ACK. Preparing dashboards and telemetry exports.
Liam (Oncall): ACK. I'll standby for bridge.
Irene (CSM): Thanks all 12; sharing this in the customer onboarding doc now.
